content.text: 0 seconds of 4 minutes, 7 secondsVolume 0% Fudd, Fam among top prospects ahead of WNBA draft April 11, 2026 07:13 PM Meghan McKeown breaks down the top prospects in the upcoming WNBA Draft, highlighting key players including Azzi Fudd, Awa Fam, and Lauren Betts, and what they bring to the next level. The WNBA’s orange carpet was rolled out for the 2026 WNBA Draft on Monday, April 13 at 7 p.m ET at The Shed at Hudson Yards in New York City. This draft was the first WNBA Draft for the two newest WNBA expansion teams, the Portland Fire and Toronto Tempo. Like last season, the Dallas Wings had the first pick.
